reason: The endpoint is already gated by OrganizationAuditPermission (src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py:40, src/sentry/api/bases/organization.py:110-124), which restricts GET access to active superusers or callers with org:write (only manager/owner roles per src/sentry/conf/server.py:2177-2276), so regular members of open-membership orgs are rejected before reaching line 71. Moreover, organization_context.member.has_global_access (src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py:71) reads the legacy OrganizationMember.has_global_access BooleanField(default=True) (src/sentry/models/organizationmember.py:216), not the open-membership-based request.access.has_global_access property.
